exposures.description: Earlier Route A results remain in worker memory; only sanitized odd inputs and named common receipts were supplied.
Search 1 returned current PEP 667, its mirrors/source and related PEP 558 snippets. None was opened or treated as original supplier evidence; queries and earliest-draft predicates remained fixed.
The official frame/reflection manuals mention PEP 667 and version-3.13 changes. Those references were not followed.

selection_rationale: Search 1's first eligible supplier original after the excluded current PEP was the versioned 3.13 frame C API at provided rank 2. It directly covers the requested explicit-frame mapping. Its observed locals and Reflection links were opened strictly as evidence-body targets (no navigation/index use); Reflection addresses the frozen old-API and current-frame requirements. The common inspect attribute tables did not establish mutation. Duplicate versions/translations, current proposals and third-party snippets were not opened.
